name: Plank
instructions: Place your forearms on the floor with your elbows directly under your shoulders and your feet hip-width apart.
Lift your body so it forms a straight line from head to heels, tightening your stomach and glutes.
Hold the position while breathing steadily, then lower your knees to the floor to finish.
technique_considerations: Keep your hips level with your shoulders instead of letting them sag or rise.
Look at the floor just ahead of your hands to keep your neck relaxed.
Stop the set when you can no longer hold a straight line, and rest on your knees.
